title: LLV-GRF320-DENSE: smaller counted classical backing with linear coherent storage

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), the ONE PHYSICAL LLV-GRF320-DENSE interpreter in proof.md executes the complete unchanged virtual program in virtual.md. Its main branch n>=2^4096 uses the same exact period-six fan-in, prefix capacity, finishing call, MERGEF/FIND, Dbar,Dcap,Ccap,Qcap and all-modulus decoder; the explicit finite branch is unchanged. Entire-secret unconditional success is at least1-2^-8. On EVERY branch including errors, failed/discarded work, source/leaf aborts, initialization and cleanup, charged time is O(2^((1/2)sqrt(n)log2n)), exact index1/2. The virtual strict sqrt(n) margin pays all separately charged dense interpretation. All constants are absolute and all four resources hold jointly for this SAME implementation under independent ideal DCP copies and clean fraction0. Let t=n+2,ell=bit_length(n-1),d=max(1,ell),lambda_bank=ceil(6ell/5),E=2^lambda_bank,A=2^16t,W=ceil(2^128t^2E/d),H=2^32t. The seven W-bit regions are ordinary CLASSICAL bits; H original coherent wires are allocated SEPARATELY, with every inactive cell counted. Mtab=ceil(8t/d), four Mlist=ceil(256tE/d) arrays and four Mres=ceil(8tE/d) arrays include full labels, frames, metadata and scratch by the all-size d*t<=12E proof. All genuine phase/query/source states remain quantum; the backing holds only classical records and handles. Every source fee, full combined-memory address fee, ordinary bit operation, serial original quantum lookup, arithmetic, gate generation, source move, reset and complete cleanup is counted. No quantum-addressed memory or inverse/controlled source is assumed.
